scope: All 33 previously pending standalone radio/DIY entries, excluding separately owned LILYGO/computing families. This follow-up resolves exact source CAD and assembly variants without changing canonical component geometry or native assets.
rules: A 2.54 mm chip/tag/reference-carrier value is not installed-header assembly evidence.
Pending source/assembly entries are unresolved candidates, not assertions that their actual 2.54 mm headers cannot fit.
All 56 existing contact IDs in the five enabled boards are retained; only complete reviewed strips are inserted.
Mounting views activate only on newly fitted parts; raw and old scale-only instances preserve prior definitions/artwork/native exports.

entries.name: Waveshare 1.3-inch SH1106 OLED (B)
entries.reason: The manufacturer ordering table explicitly identifies B as straight/vertical and A as curved/horizontal, while both use a shared A-style dimension illustration. The current dimension drawing establishes the 40.5 ×37.5 mm PCB and mounting-hole inset, but neither it, the manual nor H2 in the schematic specifies numerical installed-post pitch/offset. The full eight-ID pinout matches. This is a credible straight-header candidate awaiting a complete source-coordinate post/body map, not a rejection of B because the shared illustration has a bent header.

entries.reason: The exact 5 A manufacturer photo shows a side-facing bent three-pin 5V/OUT/GND strip and a two-position current screw terminal. A straight downward strip is plausible, but post/body coordinates for that assembly are not dimensioned. The high-current terminals remain cable connections.

entries.name: Keyestudio ACS712 20 A Current Module
entries.reason: The exact 20 A manufacturer photo shows a side-facing bent three-pin 5V/OUT/GND strip and a two-position current screw terminal. entries.name: Keyestudio ACS712 30 A Current Module
entries.reason: The exact 30 A manufacturer reference identifies the same five electrical terminals, but a straight downward signal-header assembly still needs its own complete post/body map. entries.name: Makerfabs MP1584EN Mini Buck Module
entries.reason: The exact product identifies the green D-SUN MPC1518EN module with four separated corner solder contacts. Those are wire lands, not one reviewed straight 2.54 mm header strip. Full four-post row/column spacing and underbody clearance must be verified for a soldered-post assembly; no generic MP1584 chip footprint is substituted.

entries.name: DFRobot Solar Power Manager 5V V1.1
entries.reason: The exact V1.1 manufacturer layout/dimension drawings establish the 63 ×33 mm board and P3/P4/P5 power/control banks. They do not dimension the installed posts or independently establish a complete downward population, the P5 GND/EN/BAT relationships and retained cable contacts. The 3×3-looking area must not be seated in a way that shorts control and supply nets.

entries.name: HC-SR501 Adjustable PIR Motion Sensor
entries.reason: The Joy-IT lens-side and connector-side photos show that the lens-up assembly has electrolytic capacitors, the two trimmers and mode jumper below the PCB alongside the three supply/output contacts. A simple mirrored three-pin view would hide this real underside material. Exact downward-post pitch, lead protrusion and adequate standoff clearance remain unverified; lens diameter or a generic three-pin carrier is insufficient.

entries.name: NXP BRKT-STBC-AGM01 9-Axis Sensor Breakout
entries.reason: The NXP Rev C quick-reference card identifies the two nine-position through-hole banks and adjacent test points, but does not establish installed-header row separation or material outline dimensions. entries.name: MAX3485 RS-485 Breakout
entries.reason: The linked Analog Devices page identifies the MAX3485 chip, not the anonymous eight-contact RS485 breakout PCB. A matching manufacturer module or supplied variant photo with complete TTL/RS485 connector geometry is required; the chip datasheet cannot establish board header centers.

entries.name: RS-485 to UART (HW-0519)
entries.reason: The linked Tasmota integration page is a third-party HW-0519 wiring reference rather than manufacturer board CAD. It identifies a TTL bank and RS485 terminal block but not exact downward post centers, physical body/terminal projections and board revision. Keep it available for wire connections without inventing a fitted geometry.

entries.name: RS-485 Soil Sensor
entries.reason: The exact DFRobot SEN0600 reference describes a sealed soil probe with four external supply/RS485 cable conductors. There is no downward male pin-header assembly on this component; its four cable endpoints remain usable.

entries.name: ADS1220 24-bit ADC Breakout
entries.reason: The TI ADS1220 datasheet identifies the ADC silicon, not this generic sixteen-contact breakout PCB. A manufacturer/equivalent exact board revision is required for its two physical banks and inter-row spacing; neither the bare IC package nor a reference carrier is module evidence.

entries.name: ST3215 Serial Bus Servo
entries.reason: The Waveshare ST3215 is an enclosed serial-bus servo with a three-conductor supply/data cable interface, not a module with downward breadboard posts. The servo body and cable contacts remain separate from breadboard insertion.

entries.name: SSD1306 OLED Display
entries.reason: The generic four-pin SSD1306 board has no manufacturer source. Several common OLED boards reverse GND/VCC or change their pin count, pitch/offset and header orientation. An exact matching GND/VCC/SCL/SDA board revision or supplied photo is needed before creating a physical insertion view.

entries.name: LM2596 Buck Converter
entries.reason: The TI source identifies the LM2596 regulator silicon; it does not identify the generic buck PCB or dimension its four separated wire lands. Exact board/contact dimensions and a complete downward-post assembly remain unresolved. A common chip name is not evidence for a particular module spacing.
